The preset lists the rules of the three layers and the ranking weights.
deep_value and qarp are the two other presets; they change thresholds and weights.

text.tspan: survivor metrics
value = highest passing value indicator score
quality = (ROIC − sector WACC) + ROE; a missing ROE counts 0
growth = revenue compound annual growth rate (CAGR)
= (last ÷ first)^(1 ÷ (years − 1)) − 1
growth = 0 when fewer than two years or first ≤ 0
percentile of each metric over all survivors
percentile = 0-based rank among distinct values
÷ (distinct values − 1)
ties share a percentile
one survivor or all values equal: 1
score = 100 × (0.40 × value + 0.30 × quality + 0.20 × growth + 0.10 × margin of safety)
value, quality, growth: the percentiles
first pass: score every survivor with margin of safety 0.5
best first, ties by ticker
--top given?
yes: keep the best N
no: keep every survivor
second pass: value each kept ticker by DCF
margin of safety = intrinsic value ÷ price
with config/assumptions/TICKER.yaml when present
rates of the valuation currency from config/currencies.yaml, the table the gate used
valued?
no (unknown ticker, missing data, incomplete assumptions):
keeps margin of safety 0.5
re-blend the score with the real margin of safety
percentiles kept from the first pass over all survivors
re-sorted best first
persist the run
one new run id
kept survivors: rank, score, value, quality and growth scores,
margin of safety, passed and failed rules, passed = true
rejected companies: passed = false with their failed rules

g.text: Gap: plano sec card says the screener always uses the latest (corrected) statement; screen and analyze read only rows with is_restated false.
Gap: ROIC tax falls back to the US 21% whenever the country has no Damodaran tax rate (or one outside [0, 1)), not to a rate of that country.

terms: return on equity (ROE), earnings per share (EPS), book value (BV), enterprise value (EV), earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT), earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA).
net debt = total debt − cash; a missing term counts as 0; both missing: empty
price-to-earnings P/E = close ÷ EPS, only when EPS > 0
BV per share = total equity ÷ diluted shares
price-to-book-value P/BV = close ÷ BV per share, only when > 0
EV ÷ EBITDA = (market cap + net debt) ÷ EBITDA
ROIC = EBIT × (1 − tax) ÷ (total debt + total equity); a missing term counts as 0; both missing: empty
free cash flow yield = free cash flow ÷ market cap
operating margin = EBIT ÷ revenue, per year
Histories (revenue, operating cash flow, diluted shares, operating margin) drop empty years.
Otherwise a missing input leaves the ratio empty.
Gap: plano damodaran card says the engine still resolves missing benchmarks layer by layer; the coverage gate removes the company before any rule runs (ADR 0006 (Implemented)).
Gap: plano a-wacc card says the sector WACC's only consumer is roic_above_sector_wacc; the coverage gate requires it too, and the portfolio's sector_recalibrated event diffs it.
Every layer still runs on a failing company, so its failed rules are all recorded.
Gap: plano t-rev card and leccion cap-4 say revenue may fall at most 5% a year on average; the code needs average growth > −5%, so exactly −5% fails.
Gap: spec §6.4 exempts dilution from justified mergers and acquisitions; the code caps growth unconditionally.
Gap: spec §6.5 puts margin stability in the quality score and free cash flow growth in the growth score; the code uses (ROIC − WACC) + ROE and revenue CAGR only.
Each weight is in [0, 1] and the four sum to 1; otherwise the preset fails to load.
The margin of safety is the raw intrinsic value ÷ price, not a percentile, so the score has no ceiling at 100.
Survivors cut by --top are not written.
